do: Use a flat warm off-white canvas and one idea per screen, shown big: the main card or element fills most of the space below the header, with even margins.
Keep a grey Inter uppercase section label at top left and a navy series pill at top right; change them only with the section.
Use navy for headings and cards, saffron only for highlights or changed material, green only for correct answers, and red only for wrong or rejected ideas.
Build one point on its spoken word, then hold it still long enough to read; space visual beats about 3 to 5 seconds apart.
Use dark ink outlines about 3 px wide with rounded ends for simple flat icons.
Put exact definitions, quotations and formulae in Georgia on cream document cards with a thin gold border and a grey source below.
Use Inter for slide text and Caveat only for a small handwritten note; keep primary text large enough for a phone.
Use at most one hand-drawn annotation per screen, such as a saffron underline, circle, tick or arrow.
Use sourced figures for charts and tables, and label their source.
Use a navy quick-check card with a pale saffron label, white question, quiet ring timer and green answer pill; use green ticks in recaps.
Real photos usually look best as paper cut-outs or with a white paper border and soft shadow; use another treatment (full-bleed, framed, cropped to a detail) when it suits the moment better.
dont: Do not crowd a screen with more than five items or overlap text.
Do not use colour for decoration or add glows, gradients, heavy texture or constant motion.
Do not invent numbers, source text, quotations, chart values or map facts.
Do not fake real people or documents; use real photos from the materials, with their credit.
Do not change layout during a point's reading hold or animate the fixed section label and series tag.

css: .vs-scene { background: #f7f5ef; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; color: #1d2433; } .vs-scene .heading { fill: #24406e; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; } .vs-scene .supporting, .vs-scene .section-label { fill: #6b7280; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; } .vs-scene .section-label { letter-spacing: .14em; } .vs-scene .document-text { fill: #1d2433; font-family: Georgia, serif; } .vs-scene .ink-line { fill: none; stroke: #1d2433; stroke-width: 3; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }
